mapper.sql: rule_id, template_id, rule_code, rule_name, scope_type, scope_id, scope_name, business_subtype, rule_status, current_version_id, latest_version_no, lock_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark

version_id, rule_id, version_no, version_status, definition_snapshot, definition_checksum, published_by_user_id, published_by_name, published_time, lock_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.select: select from approval_rule_version where rule_id = #{ruleId} order by version_no desc
select from approval_rule_version where rule_id = #{ruleId} and version_status = 'DRAFT' order by version_no desc limit 1

select from approval_rule r where r.template_id = #{templateId} and r.rule_status = 'ACTIVE' and r.current_version_id is not null and (r.business_subtype = 'ALL' or r.business_subtype = #{businessSubtype}) and ( r.scope_type = 'ALL' or (r.scope_type = 'STORE' and r.scope_id = #{anchorDeptId}) or (r.scope_type = 'AREA' and exists ( select 1 from sys_dept anchor where anchor.dept_id = #{anchorDeptId} and anchor.del_flag = '0' and anchor.status = '0' and (r.scope_id = anchor.dept_id or find_in_set(r.scope_id, anchor.ancestors)))) ) order by r.rule_id
select from approval_rule where template_id = #{templateId} and rule_status = 'ACTIVE' and current_version_id is not null order by rule_id

select condition_id, version_id, condition_order, field_code, operator_code, value_type, value_text, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_rule_condition where version_id = #{versionId} order by condition_order, condition_id

select node_id, version_id, node_order, node_code, node_name, strategy_type, strategy_code, strategy_config, approval_mode, required_count, missing_policy, self_policy, return_allowed, reject_allowed, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_version_node where version_id = #{versionId} order by node_order, node_id

select node_id, version_id, node_order, node_code, node_name, strategy_type, strategy_code, strategy_config, approval_mode, required_count, missing_policy, self_policy, return_allowed, reject_allowed, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_version_node where node_id = #{nodeId}
mapper.update: update approval_rule set rule_name = #{rule.ruleName}, scope_type = #{rule.scopeType}, scope_id = #{rule.scopeId}, scope_name = #{rule.scopeName}, business_subtype = #{rule.businessSubtype}, rule_status = #{rule.ruleStatus}, current_version_id = #{rule.currentVersionId}, latest_version_no = #{rule.latestVersionNo}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_by = #{rule.updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{rule.remark} where rule_id = #{rule.ruleId} and lock_version = #{expectedVersion}

update approval_rule_version set version_status = 'PUBLISHED', definition_snapshot = #{version.definitionSnapshot}, definition_checksum = #{version.definitionChecksum}, published_by_user_id = #{version.publishedByUserId}, published_by_name = #{version.publishedByName}, published_time = sysdate(), lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_by = #{version.updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{version.remark} where version_id = #{version.versionId} and version_status = 'DRAFT' and lock_version = #{expectedVersion}

update approval_rule_version set version_status = 'RETIRED', lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where rule_id = #{ruleId} and version_status = 'PUBLISHED' and version_id <> #{exceptVersionId}
mapper.insert: insert into approval_version_node ( version_id, node_order, node_code, node_name, strategy_type, strategy_code, strategy_config, approval_mode, required_count, missing_policy, self_policy, return_allowed, reject_allowed, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{versionId}, #{nodeOrder}, #{nodeCode}, #{nodeName}, #{strategyType}, #{strategyCode}, #{strategyConfig}, #{approvalMode}, #{requiredCount}, #{missingPolicy}, #{selfPolicy}, #{returnAllowed}, #{rejectAllowed}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete: delete condition_row from approval_rule_condition condition_row join approval_rule_version version_row on version_row.version_id = condition_row.version_id where condition_row.version_id = #{versionId} and version_row.version_status = 'DRAFT'

delete node_row from approval_version_node node_row join approval_rule_version version_row on version_row.version_id = node_row.version_id where node_row.version_id = #{versionId} and version_row.version_status = 'DRAFT'
